name: The Bridge 1 (BCR)

sources.label: OSM w661134293 · building=office, 11 levels, height 52, 2017: literal footprint and height
District dossier: The Bridge 1, Sos. Orhideelor 15D
The Bridge 1 on its OSM footprint (767271f)

improvements: The Bridge 1 (BCR headquarters) is a glass office box on the literal OSM footprint and 52 m height: recessed ground floor behind a row of dark columns, ten glazed storeys behind a dark mullion grid with floor bands, a flat roof edge with a plant screen, a blue BCR band at the top corner and a blue entrance canopy on the Orhideelor side.
remainingGaps: Storey height, bay width, mullion sizes, the plant screen and the sign sizes are estimates; the look comes from a street-level view used as reference only.

The model is built from the district source footprint, so it cannot be shown in the isolated viewer; the published views are in-world captures in Grozavesti, where it is background scenery (no marker, label or route).
Added on master on 2026-11-11, before the district fidelity pass; this is its first evidence record.
